title: Meta Whistleblower Sues Company Over Alleged Attempt to Silence Memoir ‘Careless People’
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: Former Meta executive Sarah Wynn-Williams has filed a lawsuit accusing the company of unlawfully attempting to silence her following her memoir Careless People, which details allegations about Facebook’s internal culture and leadership.

title: Oracle Beats Revenue Estimates as AI-Driven Cloud Growth Accelerates
author: Emily Rodriguez
excerpt: Oracle exceeded fourth-quarter revenue expectations as cloud infrastructure demand surged, but investors focused on the company's growing AI-related spending and ambitious data center expansion plans.

title: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary Signs New Contract With Potential £130M Payout
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary has extended his contract with the airline in a performance-linked agreement that could earn him more than £130 million if key targets are achieved.

title: Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Europe Over Digital Tech Taxes
author: Business Desk
image: /images/news/Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Europe Over Digital Tech Taxes.webp
excerpt: President Donald Trump has threatened 100% tariffs on imports from countries that impose digital services taxes on American technology companies, escalating trade tensions with Europe.

title: Nvidia Expands AI Infrastructure Partnerships in South Korea
author: Jessica Wu
excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveils AI infrastructure deals with South Korea’s tech giants, including SK Telecom and SK Hynix, to build AI data centers, factories, and cloud computing networks, highlighting surging global demand for AI.

title: Retiring US Business Owners Are Increasingly Selling Companies to Employees
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: As thousands of U.S. business owners approach retirement, a growing number are choosing to sell their companies to employees, creating a new wave of worker ownership and business continuity.

title: Trump Administration Launches Voluntary AI Testing Program for National Security Risks
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: President Donald Trump signed an executive order creating a voluntary framework for AI companies to submit advanced models for federal cybersecurity and national security reviews.

title: Bank of Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High as Global Markets Watch Inflation Risks
author: Emily Rodriguez
image: /images/news/Bank of Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High.webp
excerpt: The Bank of Japan raised interest rates to 1%, the highest level in 31 years, while investors monitored inflation risks, currency movements and policy signals from major central banks.
